title: Repair Unix installer and hook fixtures
goal: Keep missing-tool installer refusal coverage independent of host PATH layout and remove obsolete hook fixture code without lint exemptions or production changes.
acceptance: All three affected test targets pass and strict affected-target Clippy reports no warnings. A synthetic PATH with build tools and Unix support utilities in the same directory still exposes the real missing-tool refusal while preserving tr, grep and cleanup. Git, Cargo and rustup absence stops installation before any install-directory write.

verification.regression: The new co-located PATH test fails with the previous WITHOUT helper because tr, grep and rm disappear. The repaired test passes for absent git, Cargo and rustup before any install-directory write. The shell runner also preserves private TMPDIR.
verification.workspace_clippy: Blocked by three pre-existing useless_conversion findings in crates/susi-config/src/host_metrics.rs:398,400,401. No warning suppressions or production source changes were made.
verification.remaining: Local-only, pending combined-tree verification and gated Desktop integration. No full workspace test, publication or release qualification is claimed.
